inv.desc_en:
SALE OF PREMISES FOR PROFITABILITY ON FUENCARRAL STREET.

The premises are located in one of the most commercial sections of Fuencarral Street, with a high volume of pedestrian traffic.

It is rented to a secure and solvent tenant with a very interesting, safe, and profitable activity, with very good contractual conditions, as well as guarantees.

It has a profitability of 4.45%.

The premises have a facade of 3 meters and a surface area of 82.8m2, distributed in 66.47m2 on the ground floor and 16.33m2 in the basement.
